; cities set: cities, improvements and resources (docs/ART.md 5.7-5.8, 6, 9).
; cities.spr is generated by citystyles.mjs (with citykit.mjs): run `node cities/citystyles.mjs`
; from web/art after editing a style. improvements.spr and resources.spr are hand-edited sources.
; The unique landmarks (6.2) belong to the terrain set (improvement/landmark_*, mapped by rule);
; this set keeps only the improvement/_landmark fallback for unique types added later.
; citylight.js is the light pass (ART.md 4.4, 9.1): every pool, a city's and every other light's,
; is three nested rings that raise the ground's value toward the source (WARM, HEARTH, EMBER for
; firelight; SMOULDER and GORE for BLOOD; ARC and AURA; HAZE and HALLOW for RITE), the wall glow, the
; facade light on a lit town's lower walls, and the sprite's own lights (the tribal bonfire).
; loadArt() installs it (art.js PASSES, installCityLight). Tiers I and II have outskirts (a low house
; behind each end of the town) and windows are mostly 1x2 (citystyles.mjs, citykit.mjs).
; preview.html shows every style and a town map with it (through the terrain set's ground pass;
; ?ground=0 for the seed ground);
; ref-styles.png is its reference sheet (?part=ref, rendered with every set merged: 704x768, indexed).
set cities
source cities.spr
source improvements.spr
source resources.spr

; ---- city style per civilization (9.2, 7.3): the target is a style (city/<style>_<tier>, tiers 1-5);
; light = window colour key, pool = FIRE | BLOOD | ARC | none. Missing styles fall back to cloister.
; Variants of the Cloister and Elven kits get their own styles: amurite (mage tower, lilac light),
; calabim (dark stone), sidar (faded, unlit above tier II), svartalfar (dusk trees, lilac light);
; luchuirp adds a gear and a golem forge to the dwarven halls; barbarian is the rougher tribal camp.
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_AMURITES -> amurite light=P pool=ARC
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_BALSERAPHS -> carnival
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_BANNOR -> cloister
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_CALABIM -> calabim
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_CLAN_OF_EMBERS -> tribal
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_DOVIELLO -> tribal
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_ELOHIM -> cloister
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_GRIGORI -> cloister
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_HIPPUS -> tribal
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_ILLIANS -> frost light=F pool=none
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_INFERNAL -> infernal light=R pool=BLOOD
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_KHAZAD -> dwarven
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_KURIOTATES -> cloister
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_LANUN -> harbour
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_LJOSALFAR -> elven
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_LUCHUIRP -> luchuirp
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_MALAKIM -> sundomes
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_MERCURIANS -> celestial light=8 pool=none
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_SHEAIM -> infernal light=R pool=BLOOD
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_SIDAR -> sidar light=6 pool=none
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_SVARTALFAR -> svartalfar light=P pool=ARC
map citystyle CIVILIZATION_BARBARIAN -> barbarian
map citystyle * -> cloister

; ---- improvements: every type has a bespoke sprite (named by the convention or claimed with
; `: types`); these category rules are the fallbacks for types added to the data later.
map improvement graphical=1 -> none
map improvement mana=1 -> improvement/_node
map improvement unique=1 -> improvement/_landmark
map improvement goody=1 -> improvement/_cairn
map improvement spawn!=NONE -> improvement/_lair
map improvement permanent=1 -> improvement/_lair
map improvement water=1 -> improvement/_boat
map improvement * -> improvement/_mark

; ---- resources (6.1): every bonus has its own object (res/<name>); these rules give the glyph for
; bonuses added to the data later. WHALE is food on the map.
map bonus cat=food -> res/_food
map bonus cat=strategic -> res/_strategic
map bonus cat=luxury -> res/_luxury
map bonus cat=mana -> res/_mana
map bonus BONUS_WHALE -> res/whale
